title: Newly Whipped Tava Greek Semolina Pancakes
description: Light, aerated semolina griddle cakes whipped to a sattvic-friendly batter, seared on a hot tava, and served with a mortar-pestle pounded sweet chilli syrup.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: melted, plus extra for the tava

ingredients.name: fennel seeds
ingredients.notes: freshly crushed in a mortar and pestle

ingredients.name: mild red chillies
ingredients.notes: seeded and pounded in a mortar

ingredients.name: maple syrup
ingredients.notes: or honey for the sweet chilli sauce

instructions: Pound the mild red chillies and fennel seeds in a mortar and pestle until a coarse paste forms.
Whisk the pounded mixture into the maple syrup in a small bowl to create the sweet chilli sauce.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the fine semolina, whipped yogurt, melted butter, and warm water.
Whisk the batter vigorously for three minutes to incorporate air and let it rest for ten minutes.
Fold the baking powder into the rested batter just before cooking to create a light, bubbly texture.
Heat a seasoned cast iron tava griddle over medium heat and brush it lightly with melted butter.
Pour a small ladle of batter onto the hot tava without spreading it too thin.
Cook for three minutes until bubbles pop on the surface and the bottom turns golden brown.
Flip the pancake carefully and cook the other side for an additional two minutes.
Serve the warm, aerated pancakes immediately with a generous drizzle of the sweet chilli sauce.
